tool_args.rationale: The baseline sweep shows a monotone saturating supply response, while the open-branch contrast shows a strong dependence on s_grad. Fit the smallest smooth candidate combining exponential saturation in u_now with a gradient-dependent offset whose magnitude can vary with u_now. No high-frequency sign oscillation is present.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The acquired branch contrast adds low- and high-gradient observations, complementing the five supply sweep points; an additional probe is not necessary for fitting this four-parameter candidate.

The verified queue note is a plausible competing mechanism, but the observed baseline sweep is smooth and saturating rather than exhibiting a hyperbolic blowup; gradient contrasts also require a gradient-dependent term.
The baseline response visibly bends toward saturation as u_now rises, inconsistent with a pure linear response.
The seven observations support a compact fitted candidate, and the stated forecast horizon matches all observed horizons; defer this higher-cost probe.
